title: Ball hits player's own equipment
question: If you hit a shot and your ball accidentally hits your own golf bag, what should you do under the Rules?

choices.text: Add one penalty stroke and replay the shot.
Play the ball from where it comes to rest, with no penalty.
Pick up the ball and drop it as close as possible to the bag.
Move your bag and replay the shot.

explanation: According to the Rules, if your ball in motion accidentally hits your own equipment, you must play the ball as it lies without penalty.
imagePrompt: A teenage boy golfer on the fairway, looking surprised after his shot has deflected off his golf bag. He is preparing to play the ball as it lies.
imageAlt: Teen boy golfer on fairway, golf ball has bounced off his bag, ready to play the ball as it lies.

imageVerification.repairPrompt: No major repairs required. Minor suggestion: Ensure the emotion on the golfer's face does not appear overly cartoonish to keep the semi-realistic tone.
